title: Letter confirming a client's instructions
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Professional Ethics and Skills drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer.

parts.why: The letterhead: the sender's name, address and contacts at the top. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

References come before the date; leave them blank if none was given. Letters are dated; notices and resolutions carry their date at the end. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The addressee's name or office and address, before the salutation. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The salutation. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: LETTER OF CONFIRMATION OF INSTRUCTIONS IN RESPECT OF {{subject}}
parts.why: The subject heading. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
We write further to your oral instructions to us on {{instructionDate}} in respect of the above subject matter. The instructions are as follows:
#. {{instructions}}

Kindly confirm that the above reflects your instructions to us.

We shall appreciate your early response.
parts.why: Records the client's oral instructions point by point and asks the client to confirm them, so there is no later dispute about the scope of the brief. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

The complimentary close, the signature space, and the name and capacity of the person signing. Always sign a draft in the exam. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Sender
fields.question: Who is the letter from? The law firm, company or person, as it appears on the letterhead.

fields.label: Sender's address and contacts
fields.question: The sender's address, email and phone number for the letterhead.

fields.label: Date of the letter
fields.question: What date should the letter bear? Use a date close to the facts, never after the exam date.

fields.label: Addressee
fields.question: Who is the letter to? Give the name or office, for example The Divisional Police Officer.

fields.label: Capacity of the person signing
fields.question: In what capacity do they sign? For example: Principal Partner, Company Secretary.
